s1.text: The factory says it's certified. The PDF doesn't say what you think.

s2.text: The certifier? The factory. On imports, it's usually the importer.

s3.text: A name isn't enough. Address, email and phone, too.

s4.text: Plus when it was made. Test passed. Certificate didn't.
